lesson.uz:
If blokining sharti True bo‘lsa, Then shoxi bajariladi. False bo‘lsa Else shoxi bajariladi. >, <, >=, <= va = bilan solishtiring.
Bitta If bilan boshlang: natijaga dastlabki qiymat bering, shart bajarilganda uni yangilang. Chegarani tekshiring: 100 dan katta (>100) va kamida 100 (>=100) bir xil emas.
lesson.en:
An If condition selects Then when True and Else when False. Compare using >, <, >=, <= and =.
Start with one If: assign a default result, then change it when the condition holds. Check boundaries: greater than 100 (>100) differs from at least 100 (>=100).
